entries.en: In a bid to quell mutinous murmurings within the guild, Forgemaster H'naanza has decided to entrust you with a prestigious commission.
entries.fr: Le maître de guilde H'naanza a une commande à vous confier.
entries.ja: 甲冑師ギルドのハ・ナンザは、冒険者に製作を依頼したい仕事があるようだ。

entries.en: H'naanza has asked you to undertake the commission of a wealthy and highly respected client on her behalf. To learn more about the job, make your way to the Fishermen's Guild and seek out Nortyrwyb, the customer's maidservant.
entries.fr: H'naanza vous a demandé de vous charger à sa place de la commande passée par un riche marchand. Allez voir sa servante Nortyrwyb près de la guilde des pêcheurs.
entries.ja: ハ・ナンザから、自分の代わりに大富豪の依頼を受けてほしいと頼まれた。漁師ギルド付近にいる大富豪の使い「ノルティルウィブ」と話そう。

entries.en: Upon arriving at the Fishermen's Guild, a rather nonplussed Nortyrwyb explains that Blanstyr has already accepted her master's commission as the armorers' appointed representative. Clearly, there has been some sort of misunderstanding... Track the veteran craftsman down and attempt to resolve the matter.
entries.fr: Nortyrwyb vous a expliqué que la commande de son maître avait déjà été acceptée par Blanstyr. Allez voir ce dernier pour savoir quelles sont ses intentions.
entries.ja: ノルティルウィブから聞くところによると、すでにブランシュティルが仕事に名乗りを上げているそうだ。甲冑師ギルドの「ブランシュティル」に話を聞いてみよう。

entries.en: In order to decide who should have the honor of taking the commission, Blanstyr proposes a contest of skill. Craft an all-surpassing suit of steel chainmail and deliver it to the Roegadyn artisan for appraisal alongside his own work.
entries.fr: Blanstyr vous a proposé de vous mesurer à lui en forgeant chacun . Fabriquez-en une et remettez-la-lui.
entries.ja: ブランシュティルと、甲冑師としての腕を競うことになった。「」を1着製作し、甲冑師ギルドの「ブランシュティル」に渡そう。
entries.frMacro: Blanstyr vous a proposé de vous mesurer à lui en forgeant chacun <frnoun(ItemHQ,1,3096,1,1)>. Fabriquez-en une et remettez-la-lui.
entries.jaMacro: ブランシュティルと、甲冑師としての腕を競うことになった。「<sheet(ItemHQ,3096,0)>」を1着製作し、甲冑師ギルドの「ブランシュティル」に渡そう。

entries.en:
Blanstyr is both impressed and dismayed by the quality of your chainmail. Though he admits defeat, it is plain that the old artisan has no intention of putting the matter behind him. You have acquired a bitter rival this day. Continue to strive for mastery over your craft and prepare yourself for the inevitable confrontation to come.

※The next armorer quest will be available from H'naanza upon reaching level 35.

entries.en: But that does not change the fact that your allegiance remains a subject of public debate─one which threatens the unity of the guild.
entries.fr: Ce n'est toutefois pas aussi clair pour ceux qui ne te connaissent pas aussi bien que moi.
entries.ja:
ただ、あんたのことを良く知らない奴は不安なんだよ。
ギルドとしても、そこのところが問題さ。

entries.fr: J'aimerrrais donc faire quelque chose pour changer ça et rassurer tout le monde.

ここで私寄りの態度をわかりやすく示してくれると、
連中も安心するんだがね。

entries.en: Specifically, I would have you accept the commission of a valued client on my behalf. That, I think, would serve as proof of both my faith in you, and of your support for the guild's present course.
entries.fr: Que dirais-tu par exemple de t'occuper d'une commande à ma place ? Cela prouverait effectivement que j'ai confiance en toi.
entries.ja:
たとえば……私の名代として、仕事を受けてみるとか。
そうやって信頼を形にしてみせるのがいいと思うんだ。

entries.en: The order comes from a resident of Costa del Sol─an extremely wealthy and discerning gentleman who will accept nothing less than the finest-quality armor. As you may imagine, his patronage is of great value to the guild. I need hardly add that I would not entrust this commission to an armorer in whom I had aught less than the utmost faith.

entries.en: Regrettable though this situation may be, I would hesitate to shame your colleague by stripping him of his commission─given all the sterling work he has done for us in the past, I mean...

entries.en: Rhalgr Himself would struggle to stick a dagger through that steel. An' look at that luster... Strength an' beauty in equal godsdamned measure!

entries.en: That's an old tradition among us armorers, 'case ye didn't know. The loser o' these contests gets the job o' deliverin' the victor's goods.
entries.fr: Ça m'apprendra à te sous-estimer. Mais méfie-toi, car j'sais à quoi m'en tenir maintenant.
